title: Do LLMs Have Values? A Quantitative Analysis and Alignment Framework for Values in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting LLM value expressions and human survey profiles from the World Values Survey (WVS) into a shared 10-dimensional space to measure alignment gaps and distributional differences between model values and diverse national populations.

Administering 242 structured prompts based on the World Values Survey to assess model preferences across political, religious, economic, and social dimensions, quantifying them using the Schwartz Theory of Basic Human Values.
